articles.headline: Strength of schedule (SOS) cheat sheet: Every team's year-to-date and rest-of-season ratings
articles.description: Ranking each team's remaining schedule and how it might impact every position's fantasy performance.
articles.headlineJa: 対戦相手の強さ(SOS)早見表：全チームの現在までおよびシーズン残り期間の評価
articles.descriptionJa: 各チームの残り日程をランク付けし、それがファンタジーの各ポジションのパフォーマンスにどのような影響を与えるかを分析します。
articles.body:
The fantasy football strength of schedule cheat sheet is a breakdown of each team's remaining schedule and rank how easy/hard their collective opponents are in terms of allowing fantasy points to each offensive position: quarterback, running back, wide receiver, tight end, D/ST and kicker. 

This tool can help inform your waiver wire and trade decisions, or assist you in making those tough weekly lineup decisions, but please note that they are already factored into the weekly projections.

"YTD" represents how easy/hard each team's schedule has been thus far. "ROS" indicates how easy/hard each team's schedule will be moving forward, through the end of Week 17. The lower numbers, in green, are for the easier matchups.  Higher numbers, in red, are harder.

Please click here for a more detailed view of the fantasy strength of schedule by position in PDF cheat sheet form.

articles.headline: William Saliba 'ready to go' for Arsenal after injury at World Cup
articles.description: William Saliba has returned to full training at Arsenal, 3½ months after his last game -- in the World Cup semifinals for France.
articles.headlineJa: ウィリアム・サリバ、ワールドカップでの怪我から復帰しアーセナルで「準備完了」
articles.descriptionJa: ウィリアム・サリバがアーセナルでのフルトレーニングに復帰。フランス代表としてワールドカップ準決勝に出場した最後の試合から3か月半が経過しました。
articles.body:
LONDON -- William Saliba has returned to full training at Arsenal, 3½ months after his last game -- in the World Cup semifinals for France.

Saliba has been out of action with a back injury that didn't require surgery but an extended period of rehabilitation, Arsenal said in July.

- Madueke: Mac Allister tried to 'bait me' into red

- Marcotti: How Arsenal got a big win at Liverpool; Milan derby drama; Carrick's future; more

The center back took part in a training session on Tuesday, a day before Arsenal's Champions League match at Slavia Prague, and manager Mikel Arteta said in a pre-game news conference hours later that Saliba "is in a really good place."

"His evolution has been as expected, which is not always the case" Arteta said. "He feels very comfortable. He played 45 minutes behind closed doors last week. He feels ready to go now, so whether we use him or not is a matter of what the team needs."

Saliba hasn't played since being substituted during the first half of France's 2-0 semifinal loss to Spain at the World Cup.

Saliba has struck up an impressive, years-long center-back partnership with Gabriel Magalhães that was key to Arsenal winning the Premier League last season.

However, despite his ball-playing qualities and excellent reading of the game, Saliba might not be rushed back into the first team.

That's because the man who has replaced Saliba -- summer signing Ezri Konsa -- has put in a slew of strong performances and Arteta might not be ready to break up that combination just yet.

One option could be to switch Konsa to right back, where he occasionally has played for former club Aston Villa and England. Arteta also has Jurriën Timber and Ben White as options at right back.

Asked if he saw it as a "problem" that all three center backs were now available, Arteta said with a laugh: "So far we haven't had that luxury. I wouldn't call it a problem.

"We are going to have the opportunity to ... manage the congestion of the players in a much better way than we have actually done it."

articles.body:
The Champions!

The UEFA Champions League returns Tuesday for Matchday 4 and another action-packed slate of league-phase fixtures.

Key matches include Atlético Madrid's showdown with Bayern Munich, Barcelona hosting Aston Villa, and Manchester United taking on AS Roma. Elsewhere, defending back-to-back European champions Paris Saint-Germain visit Villarreal while defending Serie A champions Internazionale travel to take on Feyenoord.

In our early matches, Sporting CP was able to get a 1-0 win over Shakhtar Donetsk, while Galatasaray got a 2-0 win over Stuttgart. Finally, we have Bodø/Glimt taking on Lille and LASK taking on Slovan Bratislava to close out the day's nine-match slate.

Enjoy all the latest updates, goals, highlights, and analysis from across the matches in Europe!

articles.headline: Dumonts take over as controlling owners of Mavericks
articles.description: Sivan and Patrick Dumont purchased Miriam Adelson's shares of the Mavericks last month, making the Dumont family the controlling owners of the franchise.
articles.headlineJa: デュモン家がマベリックスの筆頭オーナーに就任
articles.descriptionJa: シヴァンとパトリック・デュモンが先月、ミリアム・アデルソンのマベリックス株式を取得し、デュモン家が同球団の支配権を持つオーナーとなった。
articles.body:
Sivan and Patrick Dumont purchased Miriam Adelson's shares of the Dallas Mavericks last month, making the Dumont family the controlling owners of the franchise with a 69% share.
Adelson has had minimal involvement with the Mavericks since she bought the majority share of the franchise from Mark Cuban in December 2023 along with her daughter and son-in-law. Patrick Dumont has served as the Mavericks' governor since the families took control of the franchise.

"It's really about long-term investment in the city of Dallas," Dumont told ESPN on Tuesday. "The Dumont family is really committed to building what we hope is the best arena in the NBA, a really significant investment in the city that will help create the new 40-year home for the Dallas Mavericks, a great experience for our fans and inspire our team to win championships. That's really what we're focused on. We had the opportunity, and we're really excited about it."

Cuban, who has expressed regret about selling the Mavericks to Adelson and the Dumonts due to being frozen out of the franchise's basketball and business operations, maintains a 27% share of the franchise. According to the terms of the 2023 sale, Dumont can purchase another 20% share from Cuban at the original $3.5 billion valuation.

"Our plan is to look at that and to do that over time," Dumont said. "I just have to tell you: I love Mark. He's been a great family friend for a really long time. He's just a super passionate Mavs fan and he's frustrated. I respect it. We're going to hopefully do him proud. That's my goal -- to make all of our Mavs fans super proud about the success of the team and win a championship."

Dumont, the Las Vegas Sands Co. CEO, has overseen a major overhaul of the franchise during his turbulent tenure as the Mavericks governor.

Dumont drew intense wrath from the fanbase for approving former general manager Nico Harrison's decision to trade perennial MVP candidate Luka Doncic to the Los Angeles Lakers months after the Mavericks' run to the 2024 NBA Finals. Dumont has since taken drastic measures to attempt to position the franchise for success as it pivots to build around Cooper Flagg, the reigning Rookie of the Year who Dallas drafted with the No. 1 overall pick after a historic stroke of lottery luck.

"The most important thing every day is just trying to work harder to get better," Dumont said. "It's something that really applies in life, but it's something that really applies to here. It's been an experience as a new owner in the league. Dallas is a great sports city. I think we have the best fans in the NBA, very passionate, and it's my job to make sure that we win and that we support our fans. I'm really focused on that. I've learned that there are a lot of things you can do -- sometimes they work, sometimes they don't -- but you've got to keep pushing, got to keep going."

articles.headline: Expected fantasy points (xFP): 2026 leaderboard for TEs
articles.description: xFP focuses solely on opportunity. Here are the leaders for 2026.
articles.headlineJa: 期待ファンタジーポイント (xFP)：2026年TEランキング
articles.descriptionJa: xFPは純粋にチャンス（機会）の量に焦点を当てた指標です。2026年の上位選手を紹介します。
articles.body:
Expected fantasy points (xFP) strips away player talent and efficiency and focuses solely on opportunity.

FORP -- fantasy points over replacement player -- is the difference between a player's actual fantasy point total (FF points) and his xFP (or expected total).

Tight end adjustments are made as follows:

Rushing attempts: No change

Rushing yardage: Rush attempts multiplied by a rusher's expected yardage based on position and rush direction

Rushing touchdowns: Rushing xTD

Targets: No change

Receptions: Targets multiplied by a receiver's expected catch rate based on depth of throw, location and position

Receiving yardage: Targets multiplied by a receiver's expected yardage based on depth of throw, location and position

Receiving touchdowns: Receiving xTD

Two-point conversions: xTD multiplied by the league average 2-point rate

Fumbles lost: Touches multiplied by the league average rate

Return touchdowns: Excluded due to extreme rareness and randomness

articles.headline: Martínez drops to Man United bench for Roma clash after struggles at Chelsea
articles.description: Lisandro Martínez has been named on the bench for Manchester United 's Champions League tie against Roma after his red card against Chelsea.
articles.headlineJa: マルティネス、チェルシー戦での苦戦によりローマ戦はベンチ入り
articles.descriptionJa: リサンドロ・マルティネスは、チェルシー戦でのレッドカードを受け、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドのチャンピオンズリーグにおけるローマ戦のベンチ入りが発表された。
articles.body:
MANCHESTER, England -- Lisandro Martínez has been named on the bench for Manchester United 's Champions League tie against Roma after his red card against Chelsea.

The defender was at fault for both goals in United's 2-0 defeat at Stamford Bridge, including conceding a penalty which earned the 28-year-old a second yellow card.

He was dropped from the starting XI against Roma by head coach Michael Carrick and replaced with Ayden Heaven.

"We have to pick a team. We have a good squad, we have decisions to make," Carrick said when asked about the decision ahead of the game by Amazon Prime.

"We have changed one or two in recent weeks, so we made the decision to go with this team tonight."

Martínez has suffered a significant dip in form this season and has also criticized director of football Jason Wilcox and the club's board.

Following his explosive post-match interview after the 2-0 defeat to Atlético Madrid, he kept his place in the team for the next game against Leeds.

Speaking ahead of Roma's visit to Old Trafford, Carrick said he had "no concerns" about Martínez's commitment despite being out of contract at the end of the season.

articles.headline: Camavinga: Mourinho as Real Madrid coach boosted my confidence
articles.description: Eduardo Camavinga said he is maturing as a player under Real Madrid coach José Mourinho.
articles.headlineJa: カマヴィンガ「モウリーニョ監督のもとで自信がついた」
articles.descriptionJa: エドゥアルド・カマヴィンガは、レアル・マドリードのジョゼ・モウリーニョ監督の下で、選手として成長していると語った。
articles.body:
Eduardo Camavinga said he is maturing as a player under Real Madrid coach José Mourinho.

After a difficult 2025-26 season, which led to speculation the France midfielder could leave the team, Camavinga, 23, is taking positive steps.

"To be honest, it was a tough, difficult time for me," Camavinga said in Tuesday's news conference ahead of his team's Champions League game at AEK.

"But I believe that behind every negative experience there are positive lessons to be learnt.

"I've worked really hard this summer and I'm a changed man. I'm more disciplined than before.

"I'm working hard to repay the trust the club has placed in me. I've given a lot of thought to the areas where I need to improve. I spoke to the manager and he gave me a real boost of confidence."

A struggle to find consistency in a season in which Real Madrid underperformed saw Camavinga left out of France's 2026 World Cup squad.

Camavinga took a short course in the business of entertainment, media and sports at Harvard Business School during the summer break.

"I went back to school," he said. "It was a very different experience. I worked on things I don't usually do: discipline -- I arrive two or three hours early to train in the gym ... My mindset has changed too; I'm a bit more mature."

Camavinga reflected on the criticism he received following Madrid's Champions League quarterfinal exit against Bayern Munich last season.

He picked up a second yellow card in the 86th minute of the second leg, which ended in a 3-4 defeat that eliminated Madrid 6-4 on aggregate.

Camavinga earned particular praise for his performance in the recent Clásico win at Barcelona.

"I'd already had time to think about that over the summer," he said of the criticism he received last season.

"It hurt. It wasn't about revenge. I work every day to achieve that sort of thing on the pitch. What I did in Barcelona will be forgotten, and I'll have to keep doing it in other matches."

Camavinga praised Mourinho's influence on the progress he has made.

"He's very friendly," Camavinga said. "He's a great manager with a rich history. You learn a lot from him every day, particularly about the mindset you need to have on the pitch."
